01.q: Why did Tí take the small grey fish home?
01.key: He doesn't like throwing things back while they are still moving.
opts: He doesn't like throwing things back while they are still moving.
Bà Sáu wanted it for dinner.
Thảo asked him to keep it for her.

01.q: Who made the wooden board game that came back from the sea?
01.key: Tí's uncle, when he was thirteen
opts: Tí's uncle, when he was thirteen
Hùng, for his birthday
Bống, from bottle tops she found

01.q: What did Bống do before they went up from the wall?
01.key: She made a short chalk mark on the harbour wall.
opts: She made a short chalk mark on the harbour wall.
She threw the board game back into the water.
She told everyone her real name.

02.q: Why did Tí have to go to Bến Vàng?
02.key: to take medicine to his uncle
opts: to take medicine to his uncle
to buy a ticket for the ferry
to visit his grandmother's old school

02.q: What came back when Bống called this time?
02.key: an old path over the hill
opts: an old path over the hill
the old ferry and its landing
a bus that stopped at every gate

02.q: What did the two walkers find when they followed the path uphill?
02.key: steps, an old landing and wooden posts in the water
opts: steps, an old landing and wooden posts in the water
a new road with a bus stop
Chú Bảy's boat, tied up by the bank

03.q: Who was standing at the top of the slipway?
03.key: Minh, the boy who went north with his family
opts: Minh, the boy who went north with his family
Khoa, who was top in maths
Cô Yến, with the list from school

03.key: He had not grown or changed since last September.
opts: He had not grown or changed since last September.
He could not remember anybody's name.
He was much taller than everyone else.

03.q: What had Minh heard about up the river?
03.key: a village the water took and then gave back for one night
opts: a village the water took and then gave back for one night
a school where nobody reads lists out
a market that opens at five every morning

04.q: What came back from the water this time?
04.key: a stilt house with one large room
opts: a stilt house with one large room
a brick house built in a month
a village of nine houses

04.q: What did Thảo do with the answer column?
opts: She left it empty.
She drew the stilt house in it.
She gave it to Cô Yến on Friday.

04.q: Why did the old woman say the house was not one of her nine?
04.key: A family of eleven would wear out more than three baskets.
opts: A family of eleven would wear out more than three baskets.
Her nine houses were all made of brick.
The house was too far from the river.

05.q: What came back when Bống called this time?
05.key: a whole night of the old festival
opts: a whole night of the old festival
a ring for a woman at the market
Minh's family's boat

05.q: What surprised Bà Sáu about the procession?
05.key: She knew the festival, but not one of the faces.
opts: She knew the festival, but not one of the faces.
She knew every person in it.
She had never heard of a festival like it.

05.q: What did the old woman's grandmother say about a child like Bống?
05.key: The sea sends them up and then comes after them.
opts: The sea sends them up and then comes after them.
They bring good luck to every lane they visit.
They come back every year in the ninth month.

06.q: What came back to the lane this time?
06.key: a way of living from a hundred years earlier
opts: a way of living from a hundred years earlier
a woman's ring and a man's boat
the old boat market

06.q: Which was one good thing about that week?
06.key: Neighbours sat outside together until late.
opts: Neighbours sat outside together until late.
The children joined more online lessons.
The fish stayed fresh all week.

06.q: Why did some people want it to end?
06.key: Medicine could not stay cold, and children missed lessons.
opts: Medicine could not stay cold, and children missed lessons.
The oil lamps kept everybody awake.
Nobody on the lane would talk to anybody.

07.q: What did Tí plan to do with Bống at the clean-up?
07.key: walk her to the water and tell her to go home
opts: walk her to the water and tell her to go home
ask her to bring the fish and birds back
leave her at the school with Cô Yến

07.q: What came back when the tide turned?
07.key: the old reef, all at once
opts: the old reef, all at once
the fish and the birds, slowly
the harbour as it was before the workshop

07.q: What did the teacher ask the person who brought Bống to the water to do?
07.key: Bring her to the teacher's house.
opts: Bring her to the teacher's house.
Clean the harbour again on Saturday.
Go to the district office with photographs.

08.q: Why did Bà Sáu sell Tí's father's watch?
opts: for four weeks of rice
to pay for the blades that cut the coral
to buy Tí a pair of trainers

08.q: What went wrong after the old market came back?
08.key: People were holding old notes that no shop would take.
opts: People were holding old notes that no shop would take.
The sellers would not give anybody change.
The fish went bad before noon.

08.q: What did the keeper say Tí had done wrong?
08.key: He chose where to stand when Bống called.
opts: He chose where to stand when Bống called.
He told Bống what her name was.
He spent a mark on a ring.

09.q: What came back when Bống called in the storm?
09.key: the village the sea took when Bà Sáu was a girl
opts: the village the sea took when Bà Sáu was a girl
the old reef in front of the harbour
Tí's father's watch

09.q: Why did the water come into Bãi Sẻ?
09.key: The village pushed the water in the bay over the harbour wall.
opts: The village pushed the water in the bay over the harbour wall.
The school's siren broke during the storm.
Bà Sáu left the boat too low on the sand.

09.q: How did they find Đạt and Hùng?
09.key: Tí whistled, and Hùng shouted from the post office roof.
opts: Tí whistled, and Hùng shouted from the post office roof.
The keeper pulled them out of the water.
Bống called them back from the sea.

10.q: What was inside the tin box?
10.key: a small brass thing, and it was warm
opts: a small brass thing, and it was warm
a long letter from the post office
Tí's old blue phone

10.q: Whose voice came out of the air?
10.key: the keeper's, from sixty years ago
opts: the keeper's, from sixty years ago
Tí's mother's, on Bà Sáu's phone
Minh's, from up the river

10.q: Where did the voice say the workroom was?
10.key: under the old mill, behind the wheel
opts: under the old mill, behind the wheel
inside the stilt house
behind the old post office

11.q: What was wrong with the science club's box?
11.key: It opened only four times out of ten.
opts: It opened only four times out of ten.
It could not read a fingerprint at all.
It was too heavy to carry to school.

11.q: On the torn page, what must Bống never do?
opts: call a keeper home
call anything back at night
go upriver past the mill

11.q: What did Bống tell them to do with the last mark?
11.key: Spend it on anything, but not on the keeper.
opts: Spend it on anything, but not on the keeper.
Spend it on bringing the keeper home.
Keep it and never use it.

12.q: Why did they row out over the old market to call?
12.key: Nothing lost was near them except one name.
opts: Nothing lost was near them except one name.
The keeper told them to go there.
Khoa wanted to see Venus from the water.

12.q: What came back with the last mark?
opts: Bống's own name, Sao
the keeper himself
the market and its sellers

12.q: How long can Minh stay, the keeper says?
12.key: as long as somebody keeps a good hold of who he was
opts: as long as somebody keeps a good hold of who he was
until he turns fourteen
until the wall is dry
